Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 18:30:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up — budget range and procurement thresholds

Thanks again for the demo and the time today — really helpful walkthrough. Two quick items I wanted to capture from our side so you can confirm ballparks: 

- Expected token volumes: initial rollout across Search & Support is likely in the 5–12M tokens/month range. If the pilot goes well, we could expand to 20–30M qtrly.
- Procurement thresholds: our standard is: corporate card up to $50k/year, PO required for purchases > $50k, and anything > $250k requires legal review and a security addendum. Typical procurement lead time for > $50k is 3–6 weeks.
- Unit economics target: our CFO is looking for ~$400 / 1M tokens as an upper bound to get greenlit.

Can you confirm whether those volumes map to a sensible monthly spend range on your side and whether Redwood can accept PO + Net30 terms for pilot deals? If you can send a short ballpark estimate (monthly $ ranges by token band) and any notes on contract thresholds, that’ll help us get procurement moving.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Torres

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>

Appreciate the clear summary, Elena — and great to meet the team today. Recapping and adding our ballpark estimates below so you have something to share with procurement/CFO. Attaching a short pricing PDF with tiered examples.

Recap of volumes you shared: 5–12M tokens/month (pilot) -> potential scale to 20–30M/month.

Ballpark pricing (public / list guidance):
- 1–5M tokens/month: ~$600 per 1M tokens (pilot starter band)
- 5–20M tokens/month: ~$450 per 1M tokens (volume band)
- 20M+ tokens/month: ~$350 per 1M tokens (enterprise scale)

Estimated monthly spend (using the 5–20M band at ~$450/1M):
- 5M tokens => ~$2,250/month
- 12M tokens => ~$5,400/month

I know you mentioned a $400/1M target from finance — we can explore a custom committed discount structure (e.g., 12–24 month commit) to get closer to that number. For procurement: we can accept PO + Net30 for pilots and standard enterprise contracts. For deals that require > $250k in annual commitment, our legal team will need to run a short review and we may add a security addendum (common for Private deployments).

Next steps:
1) I’ll loop in our pre-sales and finance to prepare a formal quote and a one-page SOW for a pilot (target: PO-friendly, Net30).
2) If procurement wants, we can draft a short MSA + SOW with the security addendum as an optional appendix.

Attaching: Redwood-pricing-1M-50M.pdf (short tiered pricing summary).

—Marissa

Looping in details on tiered discounts and pilot commit options for reference. Marissa — suggested internal guidance to propose to FinHub: 

Suggested public bands (for quote):
- 0–1M tokens: $1,000 / 1M (developer/small pilot rate)
- 1–5M tokens: $600 / 1M (pilot starter)
- 5–20M tokens: $450 / 1M (recommended band for FinHub)
- 20–100M tokens: $350 / 1M (enterprise volume)

Committed discount options to hit ~ $400 / 1M:
- 12-month commit at 12M/month average (annualized 144M tokens): target $400 / 1M with a 12% prepay or 30-day invoicing cadence.
- 6-month pilot commit at 5–12M/month with a $25k prepaid credit gives ~10–15% discount off list band.

Procurement handling notes:
- We accept PO + Net30 for pilots and renewed annual contracts.
- For > $250k ARR-equivalent deals, legal/security will require a short review (2–3 weeks typical) and an SOC2 evidence package.

Marissa — I’ll prepare the quote with the 5–20M band at $450/1M as the baseline and include an optional committed discount path toward $400/1M.

—Rishi
